newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Wing Tiek management buyout finalised.
newsitem.headline: Wing Tiek management buyout finalised.

text.p: Wing Tiek Holdings Bhd said three of its directors, led by the executive chairman, have signed a management buyout (MBO) agreement with a major shareholder to take over the company.

It said in a statement that Nazar Muhibah Sdn Bhd, a company owned by chairman Lew Sip Hon and two other directors, has signed a deal with Westmont Holdings Sdn Bhd for the voting rights on 30.23 percent of Wing Tiek's equity.
Westmont Holdings Sdn Bhd is owned by tycoon Joseph Chong.
The statement said the agreement was signed on April 30, but no details were given. The purchase of Westmont's holding will now trigger a general offer for the rest of the equity.
The company also proposed making a rights issue to increase its working capital, but did not give the amount to be raised.
"Further details of the MBO and the proposed rights issue will be announced as soon as they have been finalised," Wing Tiek said.
